election_office.election_day: Howard County uses vote centers, so you can vote at any of four on Election Day, 7:30 am to 7:30 pm: the Carter Day Center in Nashville, Umpire Community Building, Mineral Springs Methodist Church, or Dierks Community Building.

election_office.early_voting: Early voting is only at the Carter Day Center in Nashville. The clerk lists the same hours as the state schedule, with Saturday voting on Oct. 24 and Oct. 31.
